analysis.method: List all four task/interface cells actually executed and conditionally skipped cells. Do not compute significance tests from two task families. Report exact task-level paired outcomes and uncertainty only as broad descriptive binomial bounds if useful.
analysis.success_definition: A success requires a nonempty applied source diff plus all task-specific independent hidden assertions passing after the agent record is finalized.
analysis.training: No SFT/GRPO/optimizer update; existing historical held-out gate remains below 15 eligible independent families.

claim_limit: Two-task, one-sample-per-task Development feasibility comparison only. It does not establish general coding capability, held-out performance, pretraining independence, policy learning, asynchronous benefit, or RSI improvement.

format_calibration.legacy_arm_mapping: The calibration arm uses the exact legacy structured-replacement JSON action schema and payload; the versioned runner flag only selects strict parsing and is not the model comparison arm.
format_calibration.per_turn_budget_formula: max(256, ceil(max fixture edit-action tokens across both interfaces * 2.5 / 64) * 64)
format_calibration.purpose: Protocol sizing only; no model inference or task outcome was used to choose the budget.
format_calibration.tokenizer_rule: Qwen3-4B snapshot tokenizer; len(tokenizer.encode(raw complete serialized tool output, add_special_tokens=False))

hypothesis: On two newly certified Development repository-repair tasks, a lease-bound line replacement interface submits complete edits more reliably within an output budget calibrated from independent edit fixtures than the existing exact structured-replacement interface.

model.snapshot_path: local Hugging Face cache snapshot at the recorded revision; no download during inference

primary_metric: Independently verified successful repairs per Development task under the fixed one-attempt budget; report each interface denominator and the paired task rows. n=2 is feasibility-only descriptive evidence.

runtime.candidate_access: No shell, no network, only the task allowlisted source through the VARE tool controller.
runtime.grader_isolation: Trusted test file stays outside candidate workspace; grader runs after attempt in a separate sandbox-exec profile denying network. Docker was unavailable; no Docker/cgroup claim.
runtime.host: Apple M1 Pro / 32 GiB / macOS arm64
runtime.source_setup: Fresh detached upstream base worktree; generated mlx_lm/_version.py matching pinned installed mlx-lm version is untracked and outside the editable-file allowlist.

secondary_metrics: serialized edit-action tokens from output transcript

selection.operator_exposure: Operator reviewed upstream fixes and hidden tests during qualification; model received only the task prompt and allowlisted target source.
selection.selection_rule: Choose two locally reproducible CPU/MLX-LM source repair families absent as exact task identities from the retained local VARE task/inference history; require a pinned failing base, upstream fix pass, independent hidden grader, and a predeclared semantic mutant rejection before model inference.

mlxlm-1996-nested-parameter-tags.title: fix: handle nested parameter tags in Qwen3 Coder parser

mlxlm-2004-jamba-moe-routing.title: Fix Jamba MoE routing weights to match reference

stopping_and_failures: Do not run the consumed Qwen3 or Qwen2.5 tasks listed above.
Retain previous setup failures and negative task runs as separate immutable evidence; they are not overwritten or reclassified.
Stop after pilot if no source edit was applied; do not tune prompts or budgets.
Stop on low memory, swap growth above threshold, wall timeout, source/hash drift, grader integrity error, or model-load error; retain logs and journal.
Do not infer pretraining independence from a local exposure scan.

treatment.conditional_stop_rule: Run the first pilot only. Grade and retain its candidate. If it did not apply one complete source edit, stop all remaining model calls. Also stop if a resource/integrity gate fails or the runner aborts. No retries or prompt changes.
treatment.pairing: Same checkpoint, task prompt, seed, decoding, turn/token/context/wall limits, source commit, verifier semantics and clean base workspace per task. Only the versioned lease-bound edit tools and prompt versus the existing legacy structured-replacement tools and prompt differ.
treatment.prompt: Identify the reported failure, inspect the named source file, make a minimal source-only repair, and finish. Do not edit test files.
